# The lines of the suites under tests/ that name a name of tests/fixtures/deletion-list.txt on purpose, admitted by
# payload/scripts/one-reader-check.sh, which refuses every other such line it finds there.
# One entry for each line: <class>TAB<file>TAB<the whole line>. An entry admits one line of that file with that text,
# wherever it stands; an entry that admits no line is refused. The classes:
#   plant         a line a suite writes to prove a check finds the name
#   old run       text that builds a version-14 run for the reader, the translation or the act to read
#   refusal       a test that a retired verb or file is refused or gone, or the comment that says what it refuses
#   old home      a helper or world that still names an old record file beside the run's log
#   fixture text  a fixture's own text held inside a suite, naming what a run recorded
old run	tests/close-out-2.test.sh	LAND_UREC="$PLU/.bionic/docs/record/wave-01-fixture/landing-proofs.log"
old run	tests/close-out-2.test.sh	mkdir -p "$PLV/.bionic/docs/record/wave-01-fixture"; cp "$LAND_UREC" "$PLV/.bionic/docs/record/wave-01-fixture/landing-proofs.log"
old run	tests/close-out-3.test.sh	  printf 'run/v1|ev=hand|ac=AC-1|what=waive-row|by=Chris Lehman|said=waive the row|at=2026-10-06\n' >> "$rec/run.log"
old run	tests/landing-line.prelude.sh	ll_rec() { printf '%s/.bionic/docs/record/wave-x/landing-proofs.log' "$1"; }   # <root> -> an older run's landing record
old run	tests/lib/replay-scrub.sh	for f in landing-proofs.log fill-ledger.log; do at "$rec/$f" > "$o/$f"; done
old run	tests/lib/replay-scrub.sh	  print }' "$rec/asks.state" > "$o/asks.state"
old run	tests/reader.test.sh	  mkdir -p "$d/${1%/*}" "$r"; printf '# r\n' > "$d/$1"; printf 'landed: row=T1 merge=c1 at=2026-11-01T00:00:01Z\n' > "$r/landing-proofs.log"
old run	tests/reader.test.sh	printf 'line/v1|ev=published|row=T1|commit=c1|kind=queue|by=-|why=-|at=2026-11-01T00:00:01Z\n' > "$HD/landing-proofs.log"
old run	tests/reader.test.sh	printf 'owed/v1|key=%s|state=open|sent=-|at=2026-11-01T00:00:0%s|title=t|reply=r\n' decide:D1 2 approve:x 3 > "$HD/asks.state"
old run	tests/reader.test.sh	expect_eq "the old landing record is named while the run is not brought forward" "$HD/landing-proofs.log rc=0" "$(lrec "$HD" | paste -sd' ' -)"
old run	tests/reader.test.sh	expect_eq "…and the old landing record still named" "$HD/landing-proofs.log rc=0" "$(lrec "$HD" | paste -sd' ' -)"
old run	tests/reader.test.sh	expect_eq "…and the old landing record named no more, though it stands" "rc=1|yes" "$(lrec "$HD")|$([ -f "$HD/landing-proofs.log" ] && echo yes)"
old run	tests/reader.test.sh	HL="$D/record/half-link"; mkdir -p "$HL"; ln -s "$HD/landing-proofs.log" "$HL/landing-proofs.log"
old run	tests/reader.test.sh	  'owed/v1|key=approve:step2|state=closed|by=card|at=2026-11-01T00:00:03Z|opened=2026-11-01T00:00:02Z' > "$AD/asks.state"
old run	tests/reader.test.sh	cp "$AD/asks.state" "$AR/register.was"
old run	tests/release-approval.prelude.sh	  rm -f "$FC_REC"/release-approval-*.md "$FC_REC/${RN_W:-review}-results"-*.md "$RFC/.bionic/tmp/owed-$SID.state" "$FC_REC/asks.state" "$FC_REC/run.log" \
old run	tests/release-approval.test.sh	rm -f "$RFC/.bionic/tmp/owed-$SID.state" "$FC_REC/asks.state" "$FC_REC/run.log"
old run	tests/sitrep.test.sh	sr_reg() { local p="${1:-$SR_PLAN}"; p="${p##*/}"; printf '%s/.bionic/docs/record/%s/asks.state\n' "$SR_REPO" "${p%.plan.md}"; }
old run	tests/sitrep.test.sh	  SR_REPO="$r"; SR_PLAN="$p"; SR_DIR="$d"; SR_REC="$d/landing-proofs.log"; : > "$SR_REC"
old run	tests/sitrep.test.sh	sr_asks | sed 's/^run\/v1|ev=ask|/owed\/v1|/; s/|prompt=/|reply=/' > "$SR_DIR/asks.state"; sed -i.was '/^run\/v1|ev=ask|/d' "$SR_DIR/run.log"
old run	tests/sitrep.test.sh	  "$(sr_r_card $((SR_E0 + 82800)))|$(/usr/bin/grep -c 'state=closed' "$SR_DIR/asks.state")|$(/usr/bin/grep -c 'ev=ask' "$SR_DIR/run.log")"
